title: October 2026 incident triage
coverage_policy: Only exact upstream advisory matches with current-run asset evidence are linked. Generic completion and zero findings do not clear individual incidents. Incident investigation and unpublished candidates remain separate.

issues.title: PHP2Shell
issues.summary: PHP confirmed two memory-safety vulnerabilities. Trivy package checks were verified with current upstream data; the latest Nuclei crash probe is intrusive and excluded from this mode.
issues.next_action: Check each deployed PHP runtime against the vendor advisory and distribution backports.
issues.summary_zh_tw: PHP 已確認兩項記憶體安全漏洞；已以最新上游資料驗證 Trivy 套件檢查。Nuclei 最新範本會觸發崩潰探測，本模式不採用。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依 PHP 官方公告及作業系統發行版的修補資訊，確認每個已部署的 PHP 執行環境。

verified_upstream_fixture.scope: Inert fixture proves upstream package matching; individual user assets still require their own run evidence.

issues.title: Plex2Shell
issues.summary: Plex confirms an actively exploited chain. A version or open port alone does not establish compromise.
issues.next_action: Verify Plex Media Server 1.43.3.10861 or later and follow the vendor incident guidance for previously exposed servers.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Plex 已確認此漏洞鏈遭到利用；版本資訊或開放連接埠本身無法判定是否已遭入侵。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 確認 Plex Media Server 為 1.43.3.10861 或更新版本；曾對外開放的伺服器另依官方指引調查。

issues.title: eMudhra intermediate certificates
issues.summary: The vendor confirms weak keys in eight intermediate certificates. Checking a website does not audit client trust stores.
issues.next_action: Review browser, operating-system and application trust-store updates using the vendor notices.
issues.summary_zh_tw: 官方已確認八張中繼憑證使用弱金鑰。網站檢查無法涵蓋用戶端的信任憑證清單。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依官方公告，檢查瀏覽器、作業系統與應用程式的信任憑證更新。

issues.title: CyberCartel / Claude / Grok
issues.summary: Straiker reports attacker misuse of AI services. This is a threat campaign, not a demonstrated vulnerability in every installation of those services.
issues.next_action: Review identity, application and endpoint telemetry with the incident-response team.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Straiker 報告攻擊者濫用 AI 服務；這是攻擊活動，不能據此判定所有相關服務的安裝環境都有漏洞。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 請事件應變人員檢查身分驗證、應用程式與端點活動紀錄。

issues.title: Railway credential exposure
issues.summary: Railway reports possible access to environment variables. A repository or website scan cannot determine account exposure.
issues.next_action: Follow Railway account notices, rotate potentially exposed credentials through the provider and review service audit logs.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Railway 公告環境變數可能遭到存取；程式碼或網站掃描無法判定帳戶是否受到影響。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依 Railway 帳戶通知處理可能外洩的憑證，並檢查相關服務的稽核紀錄。

issues.title: LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply-chain incident
issues.summary: The vendor confirms malicious 1.107.0 wheels and affected containers. A dependency scan cannot rule out past execution or credential theft.
issues.next_action: Review installation records and image digests offline; do not start Python or pip in a suspected environment. Follow the vendor recovery guidance.
issues.summary_zh_tw: 官方已確認 1.107.0 套件及部分容器映像遭植入惡意程式；相依套件掃描無法排除過去執行或憑證外洩。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 離線檢查安裝紀錄與映像摘要；不要在可疑環境啟動 Python 或 pip，並依官方指引復原。

issues.title: Storm-0940 / ARTEX / ConnectWise / Microsoft 365
issues.summary: Microsoft describes abuse of previously authorized ConnectWise applications. Generic vulnerability and posture checks cannot establish tenant compromise.
issues.next_action: Preserve and review Entra service-principal sign-ins, application credential changes and Microsoft 365 audit logs using the vendor hunting guidance.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Microsoft 報告已授權的 ConnectWise 應用程式遭到濫用；一般漏洞及設定檢查無法判定租用戶是否遭入侵。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 保留並依官方調查指引檢查 Entra 服務主體登入、應用程式憑證變更與 Microsoft 365 稽核紀錄。

issues.title: Node.js October security updates
issues.summary: Node.js published runtime and dependency fixes, including eMudhra trust changes. A project manifest may omit the deployed runtime.
issues.next_action: Verify the deployed Node.js runtime against the fixed release for its branch.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Node.js 已發布執行環境與相依套件修補，包含 eMudhra 信任調整；專案檔案可能未記錄實際部署的版本。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依官方公告確認已部署的 Node.js 執行環境，套用所用版本分支的修補。

issues.title: Go certificate distrust
issues.summary: Go changed crypto/x509 verification to reject affected intermediates. Updating the build tool alone does not update deployed binaries.
issues.next_action: Verify applications were rebuilt and deployed with a corrected Go version.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Go 已調整 crypto/x509 驗證以拒絕受影響的中繼憑證；僅更新建置工具不會更新已部署的程式。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 確認應用程式已使用修正版 Go 重新建置並部署。

issues.title: GitLab emergency update
issues.summary: GitLab confirms unauthenticated code execution through integer overflow in regular-expression compilation.
issues.next_action: Verify the self-managed GitLab release against the vendor branch table and review vendor exploitation detections.
issues.summary_zh_tw: GitLab 已確認正規表示式編譯中的整數溢位可導致未經驗證的程式碼執行。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依官方版本分支表確認自管 GitLab 版本，並檢查官方提供的入侵跡象。

issues.title: Onamae Desktop Cloud incident
issues.summary: Onamae confirms unauthorized programs on some Desktop Cloud servers; disclosure concerns this service rather than all registered domains.
issues.next_action: Follow the provider notice and review affected server activity and credentials with the administrator.
issues.summary_zh_tw: Onamae 已確認部分 Desktop Cloud 伺服器遭植入未授權程式；公告範圍是該服務。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 依服務商公告，請管理員檢查受影響伺服器的活動紀錄與憑證。

issues.title: Linux ZDI-CAN-33549
issues.summary: Public ZDI and maintainer mail confirms KSMBD SMB Direct integer underflow. No public CVE mapping or distribution fixed-package mapping was verified.
issues.next_action: Track the linked maintainer thread and distribution advisory; retain full kernel package versions and relevant configuration for review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 與維護者的公開郵件已確認KSMBD SMB Direct 整數下溢問題；尚未確認公開 CVE 對應及各發行版修補套件。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤所附維護者討論及發行版公告，保留完整核心套件版本與相關設定供管理員核對。
issues.patch_status: Maintainer requests retesting a for-7.5/smbdirect development branch; not a confirmed released fix.

issues.title: Linux ZDI-CAN-33774
issues.summary: Public ZDI and maintainer mail confirms KSMBD protocol-dispatch race. No public CVE mapping or distribution fixed-package mapping was verified. The maintainer identifies a fix commit; shipped kernel releases remain unverified.
issues.next_action: Track the linked maintainer thread and distribution advisory; retain full kernel package versions and relevant configuration for review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 與維護者的公開郵件已確認KSMBD 協定分派競爭條件問題；尚未確認公開 CVE 對應及各發行版修補套件。 維護者已指出修補提交，但尚未確認已發布核心版本。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤所附維護者討論及發行版公告，保留完整核心套件版本與相關設定供管理員核對。

issues.title: Linux ZDI-CAN-33367
issues.summary: Public ZDI and maintainer mail confirms skb_zerocopy ownership handling. No public CVE mapping or distribution fixed-package mapping was verified.
issues.next_action: Track the linked maintainer thread and distribution advisory; retain full kernel package versions and relevant configuration for review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 與維護者的公開郵件已確認skb_zerocopy 所有權處理問題；尚未確認公開 CVE 對應及各發行版修補套件。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤所附維護者討論及發行版公告，保留完整核心套件版本與相關設定供管理員核對。
issues.patch_status: Maintainer reports a separate patch received and forthcoming publication; no release mapping verified.

issues.title: Linux ZDI-CAN-34068
issues.summary: Public ZDI and maintainer mail confirms vmwgfx dirty-tracking out-of-bounds write. No public CVE mapping or distribution fixed-package mapping was verified.
issues.next_action: Track the linked maintainer thread and distribution advisory; retain full kernel package versions and relevant configuration for review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 與維護者的公開郵件已確認vmwgfx dirty tracking 越界寫入問題；尚未確認公開 CVE 對應及各發行版修補套件。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤所附維護者討論及發行版公告，保留完整核心套件版本與相關設定供管理員核對。

issues.title: Linux ZDI-CAN-34076
issues.summary: Public ZDI and maintainer mail confirms nvmet Get Log Page uninitialized resource. No public CVE mapping or distribution fixed-package mapping was verified.
issues.next_action: Track the linked maintainer thread and distribution advisory; retain full kernel package versions and relevant configuration for review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 與維護者的公開郵件已確認nvmet Get Log Page 未初始化資源問題；尚未確認公開 CVE 對應及各發行版修補套件。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤所附維護者討論及發行版公告，保留完整核心套件版本與相關設定供管理員核對。

issues.title: ConnMan ZDI-CAN-32005
issues.summary: ZDI lists this candidate as awaiting public disclosure. The detailed mechanism, CVE mapping and fixed versions are unverified.
issues.next_action: Track the vendor and ZDI advisory; obtain package and configuration inventory for an administrator review.
issues.summary_zh_tw: ZDI 將此候選漏洞列為尚待公開；詳細機制、CVE 對應與修補版本尚未確認。
issues.next_action_zh_tw: 追蹤官方與 ZDI 公告，備妥套件及設定清單供管理員檢視。

reason_zh_tw.upstream_advisory_match: 上游掃描器已回報此資產的相關漏洞公告；請檢視原始發現與證據。
reason_zh_tw.no_applicable_check: 本次未記錄此資產適用的上游檢查。
reason_zh_tw.knowledge_not_current: 掃描器資料早於本次事件整理日期，或未提供資料日期；尚未排除此問題。
reason_zh_tw.specific_check_unverified: 本次未記錄相關上游發現；尚未確認這項特定漏洞檢查曾經執行。

upstream_review.zdi_mapping: Five Linux mechanisms verified in primary mailing-list messages; all six CVE and distribution package mappings unverified.
